title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: Male red-sided garter snakes (Thamnophis sirtalis parietalis) courting a female at a spring mating aggregation in Manitoba, Canada. (Credit: David L. Hubert).

This cover is provided by the authors of the article Trade-offs between surviving and thriving: A careful balance of physiological limitations and reproductive effort under thermal stress (https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2435.70357), which features in this issue. They demonstrate how male garter snakes navigate the trade-off between reproduction and thermoregulation in an extreme thermal environment through a combination of finely tuned mechanisms of behavioural and physiological plasticity. The narrow margin between behavioural thresholds and lethal limits suggests this system may already be approaching evolutionary constraints.
